propositions: A reusable live-style PydanticAIRunner constructed before entering disposable case fixtures retains its original repo_path, causing agentic filesystem and ticket tools to read the eval checkout instead of each case's fixture repository.
The runner's _effective_config method substitutes only per-request model and limit tuning without re-rooting the base repo_path, so injected runners do not adapt to per-case fixture roots.

Completion-focused eval cases fail when tools cannot access fixture files like src/cli.py or app/profile.py because they are searched in the wrong checkout directory instead of the disposable case store.

The fix re-roots the injected PydanticAIRunner at each disposable case store via eval_solver._rerooted and clears tickets_path so ticket tools read the fixture's seeded store rather than the checkout.
